title: Manual Cleave and Elution with On-Deck Vacuum
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the desired number of rows and columns for each plate in the protocol parameter fields.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload the required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the .py protocol file to the Protocol tab of the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map for up to four 96‑well plates, placing plates, tip racks, and the single reagent reservoir in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App’s calibration routine (refer to support articles for tips).

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to execute the protocol.
